# Reproducibility module


```{r}
# Path of folder where we are storing our results
absolute_path <- "~/Code/ResearchPractical2026/Code/"
```

```{r}
# simple function to multiply integers from 1 to 10 by parameter value ("multiplier")
get.multiples1to10 <- function(multiplier){
   numbers <- 1:10
   return(multiplier * numbers)
}

# display results for parameter value set to 3
current_value <- 3
results <- get.multiples1to10(multiplier = current_value)

# Storing our file 
todays_date <- Sys.Date()
the_filename <- paste(absolute_path,"multiples1to10--multiplier", current_value, "_",todays_date,".csv", sep="")
print(the_filename)
write.csv(results, file = the_filename, row.names = FALSE)



```
